## Où j'en suis
The PostgreSQL 17 upgrade Terraform for the staging analytics RDS is written and plan-only verified: parameter group family derived from the major version, blue/green enabled on `analytics-staging` (16.4 → 17.2), prod prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false`, and the AWS provider pinned to `~> 5.82.0` after a v6 lock-file detour. Three commits landed on `noa/rds-pg17` and draft PR #57 is open with the pg_partman prerequisite and the dbt lock noted in its description; nothing has been applied.

- [en-cours] Prod cutover prep is in place but deliberately disabled and undated.
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging 16.4 and check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` / `events_daily`, before any staging apply.
- [prochaine-étape] Get Maya's sign-off, then pick a prod window avoiding the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock on `events_daily`.
- [essai-raté] `init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6.4.0, whose breaking changes (S3 ACL, `aws_eip.vpc`) turned the plan into 37 unrelated changes — reverted.
- [décision] Pin AWS to 5.82 and revert the lock file; no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false (source: t14)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade is a separate todo, nothing run against the DB (source: t10)
